==Experience rates==
{{Main|Blast Furnace/Strategies}}
Full [[Smithing]] [[experience]] is gained from smelting the [[bar]]s. There is also an [[anvil]] nearby to smith on, requiring level 60 Smithing to access.

At the Blast Furnace, the following Smithing experience rates can be gained producing bars. The tables assume that the player is wearing [[ice gloves]] or [[smiths gloves (i)]] and, when applicable, has a [[coal bag]] or [[goldsmith gauntlets]] in their inventory, leaving 27 inventory slots occupied by ore. Hybrid bar patterns utilise 26 inventory slots for ore, as they need both the coal bag and the goldsmith gauntlets.

For better rates, use the Barbarian [[vial smash]] perk unlocked through [[Alfred Grimhand's Barcrawl]] when sipping energy restores and stamina potions.
